STATE OF ALASKA

Department of Health

Division of Public Assistance

TRANSMITTAL NUMBER: MC #66

MANUAL: Adult Public Assistance

DATE: December 1, 2022

This year Social Security announced a 8.7% Cost of Living Allowance ( COLA ) increase effective January 2023. We have incorporated the 2023 standards into the examples and Addendum 1. These standards become effective with the benefit month of January 2023. The COLA adjustment also causes:

An increase in the income limit for Substantial Gainful Activity; and

An increase in the student earned income exclusion.

We also made several changes to incorporate new policy, clarify existing policy, and align policies within our program policy manuals. Other changes are either technical in nature or clarifications that are the result of policy questions or suggestions from the field.

Highlights of these policy revision are described below. If you have any questions, contact the Policy & Program Development Team at hss.dpa.policy@alaska.gov .

OVERVIEW OF CHANGES

ENTIRE MANUAL

Changed all references from DHSS to DOH .

400-4(C) FAILURE TO PROVIDE NECESSARY VERIFICATION

Clarified that if a client provides verification before the effective date of the case closure, the verification must be accepted and the case processed accordingly.

410-3(A) WHEN IS AN INTERVIEW REQUIRED

Clarified that individuals who only receive APA /MED benefits that also receive any amount of SSI are not required to complete an annual interview. If they stop receiving SSI or they are the PI or SP on a SNAP case, an annual interview is required for APA /MED.

410-3(E) SCHEDULING INTERVIEWS

Revised verbiage for clarity.

Removed reference to request for service.

410-4 VERIFICATION

Clarified IEVS is used to check Quarterly Wages.

421-5(B) NON-IMMIGRANTS

Changed reference to USCIS documentation from paragraph to list format.

421-6 DOCUMENTATION OF U.S. CITIZENSHIP AND ELIGIBLE ALIEN STATUS

Removed link to NCOSC website that no longer provides the information needed in this section. Updated to USCIS website.

433-1 TRANSFER OF RESOURCES

Updated all examples within the chapter to reflect the new 2023 standards.

433-2(A) ELIGIBILITY FOR CONDITIONAL BENEFITS

Updated the SSI payment standard to the new 2023 amount in order accurately calculate if an applicant is eligible for conditional benefits.

433-4 ABLE ACCOUNTS

Updated 2023 Max Allowable contribution for certain ABLE account holders.

442-3(A) INCOME EXCLUSIONS AUTHORIZED BY FEDERAL LAWS

Clarified that except for wages and salaries, any assistance provided under the Older Americans Act is excluded from income.

452-1 PAYMENT CALCULATIONS

Updated all examples within the section to reflect the new 2023 standards.

452-5 COMPUTATION OF BENEFITS

Updated Assisted Living Home example to reflect the new 2023 standards.

452-10(B) TEMPORARY ASSISTANCE TO APA CONVERSIONS

Updated examples to reflect the new 2023 standards.

452-12 RETROACTIVE APA BENEFIT CALCULATIONS

Updated example to reflect the new 2023 standards.

460-5 INCOME ALLOCATIONS

Updated all examples within the chapter to reflect the new 2023 standards.

480-1(D) INTERVIEW REQUIREMENTS

Revised note to clarify that individuals who only receive APA /MED benefits that also receive any amounts of SSI are not required to complete an annual interview. If they stop receiving SSI or they are the PI or SP on a SNAP case, an annual interview is required for APA /MED.

ADDENDUM 1

Updated the program standards based on the 2023 COLA change.

A DDENDUM 3

Updated the link to Title V of the Older American Act and added MASST stipends for clarity.

We also made several changes to incorporate new policy, clarify existing policy, and align policies within our program policy manuals. Other changes are either technical in nature or clarifications that are the result of policy questions or suggestions from the field.

STATE OF ALASKA

Department of Health

Division of Public Assistance

TRANSMITTAL NUMBER: MC #71

MANUAL: Adult Public Assistance

DATE: December 2, 2024

This year Social Security announced a 2.5% Cost of Living Allowance ( COLA ) increase effective January 2025. We have incorporated the 2025 standards into the examples and Addendum 1. The COLA adjustment also causes:

An increase in the income limit for Substantial Gainful Activity; and

An increase in the student earned income exclusion.

We are making several changes to incorporate new policy and clarify existing policy.

Highlights of these policy revision are described below. If you have any questions, contact the Policy & Program Development Team at hss.dpa.policy@alaska.gov .

OVERVIEW OF CHANGES

410 Application Process

Revised to allow for digital and handwritten signatures created on an electronic device (finger/stylus to screen).

410-2 The Application Form

Revised section to include other application methods.

426-8 Eligibility for Medical Assistance

Removed reference to CAMA from this section as the program ended June 30, 2024.

433-1 Transfer of Resources

Updated all examples within the chapter to reflect the new 2025 standards.

433-2(A) Eligibility for Conditional Benefits

Updated all examples within the chapter to reflect the new 2025 standards.

440-1 Income Defined

Due to Social Security rule change effective September 30, 2024, removed food from in-kind support and maintenance (ISM) calculations.

440-3(A) The Value of In-Kind Support and Maintenance

Changed DHCS TPL email to doh.hcs.rec.info@alaska.gov

410-7(A)2 Initial Month Benefits

body:
STATE OF ALASKA

Department of Health

Division of Public Assistance

TRANSMITTAL NUMBER: MC #74

MANUAL: Adult Public Assistance

DATE: December 1, 2025

This year Social Security announced a 2.8% Cost of Living Allowance (COLA) increase effective January 2026. We have incorporated the 2026 standards into the examples and Addendum 1. The COLA adjustment also causes:

An increase in the income limit for Substantial Gainful Activity; and

An increase in the student earned income exclusion.

We are making several changes to incorporate new policy and clarify existing policy.

Highlights of these policy revisions are described below. If you have any questions, contact the Policy & Program Development team at hss.dpa.policy@alaska.gov .

OVERVIEW OF CHANGES

410-4(A) Interfaces That Must Be Checked

Changed WinStar to Alaska Child Support Enforcement Services System (ACSESS).

410-7(C) Eligibility for Medicaid

Revised section and example to align with current APA 30 day pend and reviewing for MAGI expansion eligibility.

432-4(L)6 Cash Distributions

Due to a new bill HR 42 revised section to include all ANCSA corporation distributions, including distributions from ANCSA Settlement trusts, received from July 7, 2025 - July 6, 2030 are excluded as income in the month of receipt and as a resource if retained for aged 65 or older, blind, or disabled individuals.

433-1 Transfer of Resources

Updated all examples within the chapter to reflect the new 2026 standards.

433-2(A) Eligibility for Conditional Benefits

Updated the SSI payment to the new 2026 amount in order to accurately calculate if an applicant is eligible for conditional benefits.

433-4 ABLE Accounts

ABLE regulations change from 26 to 46 effective 1/1/2026.

Updated 2026 Max Allowable contribution for certain ABLE account holders.

441-1(E)(2)B Using Actuals as Cost of Doing Business

Removed "Depreciation" from Examples of Deductions Not Allowed.

Added "Depreciation" to Examples of Allowable Deductions.

442-3(A)8 Unearned Income Exclusions

Due to a new bill HR 42 revised section to include all ANCSA corporation distributions, including distributions from ANCSA Settlement trusts, received from July 7, 2025 - July 6, 2030 are excluded as income in the month of receipt and as a resource if retained for aged 65 or older, for blind or disabled individuals.

452-1(A) APA Payments

Updated all examples in subsection to reflect the new 2026 standards.

452-5(D) Assisted Living Home Payments

Updated Assisted Living Home example to reflect the new 2026 standards.

452-6 Issuance of APA Payments

Revised benefit delivery options for APA to EBT and Direct Deposit.

452-10(B) Temporary Assistance to APA Conversions

Updated examples in subsection to reflect the new 2026 standards.

452-12 Retroactive APA Benefit Calculations

Updated example to reflect the new 2026 standards.

460-5 Income Allocations

Updated all examples within section to reflect the new 2026 standards.

Addendum 1

Updated the program standards due to the 2026 COLA .
